source_checks.finding: The original physical weight_shape is retained. Unpacking uses this shape and weights.num_bits, then dequantizes with the original weight_scale and optional zero point and group index. Symmetric zero point is removed.

Natural column-axis packing places successive 4-bit codes at bit offsets 0,4,...,28. The stored unsigned nibble is unpacked and shifted by -8 to signed INT4; this agrees with the existing source-specific component oracle.

Group size is inferred from the original code and scale shapes when no arguments are supplied. Signed codes are cast to scale.dtype and multiplied in that dtype before the final output cast. For these BF16 scales, BF16 product rounding precedes a requested F32 output, as tested by the existing 215544 source-rounding witnesses.
